fact: At a 21 September 2026 meeting on the national AI strategy, four large language models were reported, two finished and two in development, including a prototype chatbot on Algerian tax legislation.
title: Troisième réunion multisectorielle de suivi de la Stratégie nationale de l'intelligence artificielle
publisher: Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche scientifique
